capture_method: Firecrawl (Playwright capture returned HTTP 403 — the site blocks the local headless browser)
purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY — not design DNA. The owl template is the sole source of layout and structure.
strengths: Genuinely strong first-party photography and video — real crews, real slabs, real before/after pairs
Named enterprise logos (McLane, Amcor, Berry Global, Diamond H, Lowe's) sitting above the fold as social proof
Service copy is specific and technical: cure times, ASTM references, cold-storage specialism, named failure modes
Clear single conversion action ('Get a free quote') repeated consistently
weaknesses: Autoplaying full-bleed hero video with the logo overlaid on it — the headline competes with motion and the LCP is heavy
No local or service-area pages at all; six states are claimed in a sentence on /services and nowhere else, so there is no geographic SEO surface
Testimonial section repeats the same review three times, which reads as a placeholder loop rather than social proof
No FAQ content anywhere on the site — zero eligibility for FAQ rich results on high-intent technical queries
Contact form is a native Divi form with no CRM behind it; nothing routes to a pipeline
Phone number is inconsistent between the /contact page (570) 479-2629 and the global footer (570) 479-2620
A default 'hello world' post from the WordPress install is still published at /2025/12/01/hello-world
Site returns 403 to non-browser clients, which also blocks some crawlers and preview tools
No privacy, terms, or accessibility pages — footer 'Terms of Use' and 'Privacy Policy' links on service pages point at '#'
seo_gaps: Service page H1s carry no geography
No sitemap-driven internal linking between services and markets
